title: Cloud Armor: WAF rules, rate limiting and DDoS protection

videos.script: Every request to the shop passes a checkpoint before it arrives. {{edge}} Cloud Armor is a list of rules in front of the load balancer. The first rule that matches decides. {{rules}} A WAF rule looks for attacks, like SQL injection. It starts in preview, so it can show what it would block before it blocks a real customer. {{preview}} A rate limit counts requests from each client. Go over the line on checkout, and you are banned for ten minutes. That is how card testing is stopped. {{rate}} The huge floods of packets never reach you at all. Google's edge drops them. {{ddos}} One more thing. Terraform will happily accept a rule Google would refuse. You will see it happen. {{plan}}
